title: The Shining
author: Stephen King
review: The film is one of my all time favorite horror movies and hadn't read the book before. This shows how great King is with character development, non supernatural horror, and writing about addiction and isolation. The Overlook is hard to beat as one of the best haunted houses, excellent setting that's a character of its own.

highlights.text: Dying was a part of living. You had to keep tuning in to that if you expected to be a whole person.
A hoarse voice, made brutal with drink, shouted: “Unmask and let’s fuck!”
The hotel creaked around them. Outside snow had begun to spit down from a sky like lead.
“You mind your daddy, Danny! You do what I say! You do it or I’ll give you a hiding you’ll never forget. Open this door or I’ll bash your fucking brains in!”
